power_analysis.method: Normal approximation for cluster bootstrap; Cliff's δ variance ≈ 2/(3*n_eff)
power_analysis.note: With n=13 families, power to detect Cliff's δ=0.33 is approximately 42.6%. Minimum n for 80% power: 38 families. If n_families < 12, broad C1 claim must be scoped to available families.

delta_eq_info.justification: 10% is the standard non-inferiority margin in clinical trials. It exceeds measurement noise (3-5% CI half-width at n≥12 families) and is below the expected practical effect (MalPhylo targets ≥5% improvement over B1/B2). Bootstrap CI is reported for reference but not used as the margin (degenerate with few families).
delta_eq_info.note: δ_eq=0.10 means MalPhylo's cross-family recovery can be up to 10 percentage points worse than B8 (ML-features control) and still claim non-inferiority. For reference, calibration bootstrap CI half-width=0.0577 (degenerate with 13 families).
